### John 3:16 in Context
Author: John MacArthur
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/john-in-context
Passage: John 3:16
Points:
- Many modern believers wrongly believe the gospel should always be appealing and never cause offense.
- When Nicodemus approached Him, Jesus did not flatter him but directly confronted his lost, unregenerate condition.
- The gospel brings eternal life to believers, but it brings condemnation to those persisting in unbelief.
- Jesus' uncompromising candor bore fruit over time, as Nicodemus eventually believed and publicly cared for Jesus' body.
- Spiritual warfare against deception requires clarity, bold conviction, and truth rather than a public-relations campaign.

### Nicodemus Comes to Jesus
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/nicodemus-comes-to-jesus
Passage: John 3:1-2
Points:
- Nicodemus was a prominent Pharisee who sought an encounter with Jesus under the cover of night.
- Even if fear caused Nicodemus to come secretly, Jesus did not turn him away or rebuke his hesitation.
- Nicodemus recognized that the miracles Jesus performed proved that God was truly with Him.
- Biblical miracles are not routine occurrences, but special divine signs authenticating God's messengers and covenant mediators.
- Christ's gentle reception of Nicodemus encourages believers to approach the Lord freely, even when faith feels weak or timid.

### The New Birth: Awakened by God’s Spirit
Author: Derek W.H. Thomas
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://updates.ligonier.org/rs/189-JLA-216/images/Fight%20the%20Good%20Fight%20-%20A%20Devotional%20on%20Awakening.pdf?version=0
Passage: John 3:1-21
Points:
- Spiritual awakening fundamentally requires the new birth, without which no one can see or enter God's kingdom.
- Regeneration is entirely a sovereign work of the Holy Spirit, resembling the uncontrollable movements of the wind.
- God demonstrated His immense love for a fallen world by giving His only Son to rescue perishing sinners.
- Because regeneration happens invisibly at an unconscious level, its reality is confirmed only by genuine spiritual fruit and life.
- Every believer must examine their spiritual state and cry out to God for His quickening mercy and salvation.
